_comment: Paper-1 params of the dropout family (LeastConfidenceDropout, MarginSamplingDropout, EntropySamplingDropout, BALDDropout, VarRatio, MeanSTD) on DATA/daninhas_full_fixed/ (ADR 0016): identical to params_paper1.json plus model_args.dropout_p = 0.5, a dropout layer on the 2048-d pooled features right before the classifier of the DANINHAS ResNet-50, active during training and during the n_drop MC passes, as in DeepAL (KI-41, ADR 0014). Only these six strategies train with this layer, so their round-0 model differs from the other strategies' (inherent to MC dropout). See .specs/experiments/campaign.md.
